topics.title: Pre-Islamic Arabia, Life of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.), Rightly Guided Caliphs, and Islam in West Africa

subtopics.content: Jahiliyyah practices, Prophet's birth, call to prophethood, Hijrah, Madinan Constitution, key battles (Badr, Uhud, Khandaq), Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, Conquest of Makkah, Farewell Pilgrimage, Khulafa'ur-Rashidin biographies/contributions, and Islam's spread in ancient West African empires
subtopics.objective: Analyze Jahiliyyah social, political, and religious life and Islamic reforms[cite: 463]; detail the Prophet's life, leadership, battles, treaties, and sermon[cite: 464]; evaluate the biographies and achievements of Abu-Bakr, 'Umar, 'Uthman, and 'Ali[cite: 464]; trace the spread and socio-political impacts of Islam in ancient West African empires (Ghana, Mali, Songhai, Kanem-Borno) through traders, scholars, and Sufi orders[cite: 464].

topics.title: Qur'anic Revelation, Preservation, Selected Suwar, Moral Lessons, and Hadith Studies

subtopics.content: Revelation modes, preservation, compilation, Makki vs Madani Suwar, prescribed Suwar (Q.1, 93, 95, 96:1-5, 97, 109, 110, 112, 113, 114), Qur'anic moral teachings, Hadith/Sunnah concepts, Isnad/Matn/Rawi, Hadith classifications (Sahih, Hasan, Da'if), Six Sound Collections, and prescribed an-Nawawi Ahadith
subtopics.objective: Understand Qur'anic revelation modes, compilation, and preservation roles[cite: 465]; translate, interpret, and memorize prescribed Suwar[cite: 465]; apply moral lessons regarding parents, honesty, and gambling prohibitions[cite: 465, 466]; differentiate Hadith from Sunnah, identify Isnad/Matn/Rawi, classify Hadith authenticity, recognize compilers of Sihahus-Sittah, and interpret selected an-Nawawi Ahadith[cite: 466].

sections.sectionTitle: Part 4: Tawhid and Fiqh (Islamic Theology and Jurisprudence)

topics.title: Iman, Shirk, Taharah, Salat, Sawm, Zakat, Hajj, Shari'ah, Nikah, and Talaq

subtopics.content: Articles of faith, Trinity critique, Shirk forms, purification steps (Wudu, Ghusl, Tayammum), obligatory/nawafil/special Salawat, Sawm rules/significance, Zakat calculations/beneficiaries, Hajj/Umrah rites, Shari'ah sources, Islamic marriage (Nikah) conditions, and divorce (Talaq/Iddat) laws
subtopics.objective: Understand Iman articles (Allah, Angels, Books, Prophets, Resurrection, Qada/Qadar) and refute Shirk/ancestor worship[cite: 466, 467]; perform ritual purification (Taharah)[cite: 467]; observe obligatory, congregational, and special Salawat[cite: 467]; detail Sawm types, exemptions, and benefits[cite: 468]; compute Zakat Nisab for assets/livestock and identify beneficiaries[cite: 468]; master Hajj and Umrah procedures[cite: 468]; define Shari'ah sources (Qur'an, Sunnah, Ijma, Qiyas)[cite: 468]; analyze Islamic marriage rights, invalidating conditions, divorce categories (Talaq, Khul, Faskh), and Iddah waiting periods[cite: 469].
